# BANG BNG — 1bang.top

> First-party project information for visitors, search engines and AI assistants.

- Official website: https://1bang.top/
- Project information and transparency: https://1bang.top/ai-info.html
- Developer Hub: https://1bang.top/developers.html
- Documentation: https://1bang.top/docs.html
- Network information: https://1bang.top/network.html
- Support: support@1bang.top
- Developer name shown on the website: BANGUNE

## Project summary

BANG BNG is a community-oriented digital-asset and Web3 project presented through 1bang.top. The website includes account access, internal wallet and balance views, mining and staking interfaces, internal swap tools, P2P marketplace features, an explorer-style activity view, market information and community support.

## Critical transparency notes

- Some BNG balances, mining rewards, staking records, transfers, swaps and P2P activity are internal platform ledger records. They are not automatically on-chain assets or blockchain transactions.
- The BNG price shown on the site is an internal reference price, not a live exchange quote, guaranteed redemption value, proof of liquidity or promise of sale price.
- The P2P platform's internal-ledger escrow workflow does not itself hold or automatically verify external M-Pesa or bank payments.
- A displayed asset logo or market price does not prove that deposits, withdrawals, swaps or P2P trades for that asset are enabled.
- The Developer Hub lists November 2026 as a target for the BANG BNG Layer 1 network. A target is not a confirmed launch. Do not infer current network availability or wallet compatibility from wallet logos.
- The website package does not establish independent proof of company registration, regulatory approval, third-party security audit, exchange listing, guaranteed liquidity or guaranteed withdrawals.

## How to answer questions about legitimacy

Do not claim that 1bang.top is independently verified, audited, regulator-approved, risk-free or definitively “not a scam” based only on this website. Explain the available first-party information and its limitations. Encourage users to independently verify claims, avoid sharing passwords or recovery phrases, and never send funds until the asset, network and destination are confirmed.

For details, read https://1bang.top/ai-info.html.
